page.layout: One column of Hebrew lexicon entries, with Latin glosses, below a running head; page number at upper right.

main_text.p: חָגוּר m. חֲגוֹרָה, מַחְגֶּרֶת f. Cingulum, Zona, plur. חֲגֹרוֹת Cinctoria, Subligacula.
חָרַר Acutum esse, Acui. Hophal חוּחַד Acutus factus fuit.
חָרָה m. Acutus: חָרָה f. Acuta.
חָרָה Latari, Gaudere: Chaldaeis usitatissimum. Pihel חִחָה Exhilaravit.
חֲדָוָה f. Latitia. Chal. בְּחָדְוָה Cum gaudio.
חָדָה m. Chald. Pectus: חֲדוּתִי Pectus ejus, Daniel. 2.32. Est ab Hebraeo חָזֶה mutato ז in ד, ut saepe.
חָדַל Cessavit, Defiit, Destitit, Abstinuit, Reliquit. Hophal, הָחְדְּלָתִי Desistere coactus fui, Jud. 9.9, cum Segol praeter morem, vel potius interrogative, Num relinquam?
חָדָל m. Mundus, Tempus cito definens.
חָרָק m. Spina, aut spinae quaedam species.
חָדָר, חֶדֶר m. Cubiculum, Conclave, Penetrale, plur. חֲדָרִים.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the faded upper-left entries are doubtful and marked only where uncertain in the printed scan; the Hebrew forms of entries 2, 8 and 9 and the pointing of entry 10 should be checked against the scan. A faint "Copyright" mark at lower right is a digitiser's stamp and is omitted.
